description: QuillBot-killer seed corpus (Issue #8). 120 broken/vague/awkward cases. Expand to 300-500 held-out before claiming 'beats QuillBot'. Scoring uses benchmarks/eval/metrics.mjs (grammar + meaning + clause). Competitor captures (QuillBot Fluency/Standard) are manual/exports — do not automate in violation of ToS.
source: Derived from adversarial eval + hard-tail categories in #8: broken grammar, fragments, run-ons, vagueness, word salad, tense, register, ambiguity where invention must be penalized.

categories.broken_grammar: typos, agreement, fragments that must become complete
categories.ambiguity_invention_trap: ambiguous inputs where inventing specifics must FAIL
